overview: Medford City Council President Zac Bears appeared on Medford Happenings to discuss city budget improvements, public engagement, commercial growth strategies, zoning, and major infrastructure projects including the high school building initiative.

items.title: Introductory Remarks and Personal Background
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced City Council President Zac Bears, who shared details about his background and personal values as a Medford councilor.

items.title: City Budget Process and Accomplishments
items.summary: Bears discussed efforts to make the city budget process more transparent and noted the impacts of the 2024 ballot questions and recent teacher contract negotiations.

items.title: Infrastructure Backlog and Economic Growth
items.summary: Bears outlined key municipal challenges, focusing on DPW staffing levels, aging water and sewer systems, and the need for commercial growth to ease residential property tax burdens.

items.title: Public Engagement and Communication
items.summary: Addressing perceived gaps in council-public communication, Bears emphasized the importance of respectful dialogue, learning from past zoning debates, and expanding ward-level outreach.

items.title: Attracting Commercial Development
items.summary: Bears described strategies for attracting walkable, mixed-use commercial developments to city squares to help broaden the commercial tax base.

items.title: Zoning and Housing Policy
items.summary: Bears reviewed local housing needs, the city's zoning reform process, and joint planning efforts between the City Council and the Community Development Board.

items.title: Major Infrastructure: Fire Station and High School Project
items.summary: Bears detailed the timeline, potential state funding reimbursements, and cost estimates for the proposed Medford High School building project while noting the stall on a new Central Fire Station.

items.title: Long-Term Vision for Medford
items.summary: Bears shared a 10 to 15-year vision centered on sustainable revenue generation, safe multimodal transportation infrastructure, and expanding commercial opportunities.
